Overview

Jimma is a city in Oromia with a population of 250,000. A historic city in southwestern Ethiopia, known as the birthplace of coffee and a major coffee trading center. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 20.0.
